dosbox_language.description: Language file to use (e.g., 'english'). Empty string uses default.

dosbox_machine.description: Emulated machine type. Valid: hercules, cga, tandy, pcjr, ega, vgaonly, svga_s3, svga_et3000, svga_et4000, svga_paradise, vesa_nolfb, vesa_oldvbe.

dosbox_memsize.description: Amount of emulated memory in MB.

renderer_scaler.description: Graphical scaler to use (e.g., 'none', 'normal2x', 'advinterp2x'). Empty string leaves unset.

renderer_forcescaler.description: Forced scaler, even if it might not fit (e.g., 'none', 'xbrz'). Empty string leaves unset.

mouse_focused.description: Whether mouse is captured when window has focus.

mouse_emulate.description: Whether to emulate a mouse for DOS programs.

mixer_nosound.description: Disable sound output (e.g., for headless servers).

midi_type.description: MIDI device type (e.g., 'mt32', 'cm32l', 'opl2', 'opl3', 'sblast', 'none'). Empty string leaves unset.

midi_device.description: MIDI device path or identifier (e.g., '/dev/midi0'). Empty string leaves unset.

serial_ports.description: Serial port configurations. Each item maps a port index to its type. Valid types: 'dummy', 'nullmodem', 'direct', 'file', 'real', 'none'. Use only necessary ports to avoid conflicts.

autoexec_commands.description: List of commands to execute in [autoexec] section at startup (e.g., 'mount c /home/user/games', 'c:').
